claims.summary: The release targets the fresh deployed v0.15.105 UX audit where nominal 100/A output still trusted generic Fixed-point iteration and Iteration rows as UX source proof.
UX iteration source anchors now require design, prototype, usability, studio, critique, feedback, interface, interaction, or user-experience context instead of accepting bare iteration matches.
Source-finder retrieval, source-ledger export, and the deep quality grader now reject generic math/process iteration rows while preserving actual UX iteration evidence.
The release records that v0.15.105 was nominally 100/A but not strict-clean because Texture remained 94 and source relevance still needed this false-friend guard.

carryForward: Fresh deployed v0.15.106 ZIP/log audit must verify provider output no longer trusts generic iteration false friends.
Texture remains below strict-clean at 94 in the v0.15.105 audit, with five repeated 12/12 shingles across assignments, discussions, rubrics, and lesson plans.
